run_send_generate_request: run send_generate_request to send multimodal messages to an OpenAI-compatible LLM API endpoint
run_send_direct_request: run send_direct_request to perform local vLLM inference on a list of multimodal messages
create_get_image_base64_and_mime: create a base64-encoded image string and MIME type from an image file path
test_send_generate_request: test send_generate_request with image-containing messages against a server URL
test_send_direct_request: test send_direct_request with a vLLM instance and sampling params for local inference
